LEASE_PREPARATION_ATOMICITY.assertion: outer, nested and restore lease allocation failures preserve bookkeeping, release quiescence exactly once and permit retry

SAVE_FAILURE_ATOMICITY.assertion: acquire, preflight, Framework, Time, Persistence, encode, storage and throwing-provider failures retain the last valid package and permit generation retry

DURABLE_PENDING_EXACTLY_ONCE.assertion: accepted observer completion and unfinished action survive the production generation encode/store/decode path; restore retries only the unfinished leg

LEASE_LIFETIME.assertion: wrong-thread nested acquisition and capture/restore overlap fail; surviving nested lease retains quiescence until final release

LINEAGE_MONOTONICITY.assertion: a generation published between lineage read and safe-point acquisition cannot be overwritten with a reused generation ID

G5-BARRIER-001.root_cause: lease allocation followed publication of active state or nested counter increment, stranding quiescence on allocation failure
G5-BARRIER-001.fix: prepare the owning lease before no-fail publication and use scoped acquisition cleanup
G5-BARRIER-001.compatibility_impact: none; no public API or wire change

G5-SAVE-001.root_cause: next generation was computed before acquiring the safe point without verifying that another coordinator had not published meanwhile
G5-SAVE-001.fix: reread authoritative lineage under the generation lease; reject stale lineage with controlled retry
G5-SAVE-001.compatibility_impact: none; stale lineage now fails instead of silently reusing generation
